Messages.Author: Bradly Ward
Messages.Body:
Can a !nos play the action modifier Gang Tactics when you are trying to
rescue yourself from torpor? Since you dont enter combat if you are
blocked?

-brad

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Sure. It'll have no effect, since there is no combat.
